title: Review P3
summary: An independent read-only review checks P3.1–P3.14 against the reference and the P3 amendments (D19–D23, knowledge/p3-execution) and records a GREEN or RED verdict with findings in artifacts/reviews/P3-review.md.
why: Owner requested a review of P3 (brief M16). P3 moves ~200 types, splits schema/installer/health/config ownership, removes legacy persistence paths and introduces two SPI types; a fresh reader catches silent placement drift, weakened or deleted tests, guard weakening in the module copy, prune races and a core→module edge hidden in strings.

include: Placement: TargetPlacementTest result, no shim/alias, module roots and providers; I2–I5/I13 blocking with empty allowlists
D21: core sites vs #scope-description table; fingerprint and conflict rules; D22: module guard equals core guard (negative tests)
D19/D20: six-table schema, Audit chain, DDL fixtures per driver, fresh-install scenarios, prune model pairs with engine evidence
D5 item: stages free of concrete-source branches with unchanged read order
Tests: no weakened/skipped/deleted assertions except those removed by decision (git diff of tests since the P3 start commit); test counts
Migration instruction completeness; D23 cleanliness gate
Verdict, findings table {id, item, file:line, rule, severity, fix}, re-run of P3.14 V1–V4
exclude: Changing code or fixtures (read-only; fixes go through reopened items)

reads.why: Rules every P3 item follows (reference + amendments win, no shims, placement, oracle, allowlists, snapshots, migration lines, tests)
Exact validation commands, PHP 8.4, driver ports, composer update rule
What P3 changed in the reference

rules: A finding needs a file:line and the violated reference rule; style preferences are not findings.

validation.cmd: git diff --quiet HEAD -- packages tests bin docs
validation.expect: exit 0 (review changed nothing outside the plan)

result.notes: P3-review.md: reviewed tree 902ada79 RED (F1 Scopes module imported core-internal CanonicalMetadata; F2 split-only oracle part made ScopeConfiguration ownerless, invisible to I2/I3/I4); fixed with F3 (D23 leftovers in tests, resources snapshot regenerated), F4 (activation row 1 visibility), F5 (PanelCompiler docblock), F6 (register semantics, I2-I4 exists) -> GREEN. Re-run: Arch 179, Parity/Regression 147, targeted 1065, pint/rector/api green; phpstan only owner-WIP trait.unused. Full suite, driver lanes, engines, test:types and consumer archives handed to a follow-up session.
deviations: Owner 2026-10-14 asked for maximum code work with long runs handed to Sonnet/medium: findings F1-F6 corrected in this item (as P2.15), not via reopened items; V2 evaluated on the committed tree bf5ff15b with the owner's uncommitted WIP excluded by pathspec
